Throughout all of history, one thing above all others has been key to the human monkey's rise to absolute domination of this world - our ability to coordinate our actions with those of others.

If shit really goes down, there's going to be exactly three kinds of people: those that have a tribe, those that die, and statistical anomalies.

Having tons o' guns and piles of ammo is fucking great - if you can defend it. And you by yourself cannot, because you'll need to be out hunting, foraging, and shooting potential threats as far away from where you live as you can feasibly manage it. The only way this works is if you have other people you can rely on.

People often prep in terms of gear, supplies, and locations, but almost always seem to neglect the most important thing, which is that a human by themselves is nothing. You need a group, a tribe, a community. Not only to make your fight possible, but to make it worth fighting. Else you're just crawled in a hole, clutching a gun and hoping nothing comes in there after you. That's not living.

Think about who you are going to trust. Think about how you are going to link up with these people when shit goes down. Are there families involved? What can each and every person contribute? How much equipment, supplies, and possessions are you moving, and where are you moving it to? How will you secure your location, and what's your plan to get everyone out of there in the event that you can't?

Personal equipment and training will cover the first three to six months. Past that you need to work under the assumption that such will be your life now, then ask yourself what sort of life you plan to live, and how you plan to live it. Prepare for that.

And if you're plan is "solo ramboing it innawoods" then just please leave your shit neatly organised so that it's easier to loot when you die. And you will die. If nothing else, time will make sure of that. So unless you can reproduce by mitosis then someone's going to come and take your shit.
